message: JOBFLOW-1-S3-RECONCILE does not define how prompt expiry after an already-delivered generation can surface the expiry outcome while preserving exactly one terminal job.setup_card_delivery event per generation.

notes: Already defined by the plan's event contract: expiry is an AXIS-B event, not an Axis-A terminal. It reuses the job.setup_card_delivery event type with its OWN idempotency key card_delivery_expired:<promptId> - separate from card_delivery_terminal:<promptId>:<generation>. So a delivered generation keeps exactly one terminal event, and prompt expiry appends one additional expired event per prompt. setup.deliveryNotice derives from the LATEST event for the current prompt/fingerprint, so expiry naturally supersedes 'delivered' in presentation. No new invariant needed.
